title: Scalar forgetting commutes with inverse-image composition on sheaves
statement: For [def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-pullback-comparison], let Λ be a commutative ring in Type(u+1), S,Y,Y' schemes in universe u, a:Y'→Y, h:Y→S and h':Y'→S with a≫h=h'. Let L be an étale Λ-module sheaf on S and V_X the scalar-forgetting functor [def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-pullback-comparison]. Write p_f=(pullbackIso Λ f).inv and k_C=upperStarComp C a h h' w.symm [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Then p_h'(L) ≫ V_Y'(k_Module.hom(L)) = k_Ab.hom(V_S L) ≫ a*_Ab(p_h(L)) ≫ p_a(h*_Module L). This is an equation of sheaf morphisms, before applying single complexes or deriving.

proof.text: Expand the canonical scalar comparison into the Kan-extension and sheafification isomorphisms. Their unit equations show that the abelian pullback unit followed by the forgotten comparison equals the forgotten module pullback unit. Apply the adjunction hom equivalence for h′ to the proposed composition equation. The unit form of upperStarComp turns both composites into successive units. Naturality of lowerStarComp moves the two scalar comparison maps past the direct-image composition isomorphism. Naturality of the a-unit moves the h-comparison across it; apply the scalar unit equations for a and h. Scalar forgetting commutes definitionally with pushforwards and their pullback-pasting comparison. Thus both adjoints are identical and injectivity gives the equation.
